prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ONE original full-bleed vertical 9:16 watercolor story illustration for one locked narration shot. Use every input according to its explicitly labelled role; preserve the existing named identities, not just their species. Input 1: environment layout / watercolor style ONLY. Keep the geography and furnishings, but draw ONLY the requested people and props for this shot, never copy unwanted actors. This is not an image to reuse as the output.
Visible characters: NONE; no animals or people visible. Exact total number of visible characters: 0. Do not draw extra background animals. Scene continuity: imagined_calm_cove；想象中的安静水湾；非现实梦境画面
The SINGLE visual moment and framing: 纯景别：同一片细长柳叶停在原来大圆石后方水草旁的静谧水湾，水面柔和安静；以淡淡柔光表现皮皮的想象，不出现任何角色。
Mandatory pose/prop state (overrides neutral model-sheet poses): 保持角色身份一致；表情、目光、耳姿与身体动作贴合本镜具体旁白，温和自然，不复制参考图的默认表情；水彩竖屏9:16；无字无水印；重要脸部和动作避开字幕区。
Style: hand-painted gentle watercolor on fine warm paper, muted natural hues, soft edges and rounded shapes, quiet storybook mood, no glossy 3D or photorealism. Daylight scenes use soft greens and warm daylight, not bedroom amber tint. Night scenes use soft warm lamplight and muted gray-blue windows. Composition: full-bleed vertical 9:16. Keep all important faces, hands, feet, biscuits, fabric folds and other story actions in the upper 68% of the image. Bottom 32% is low-detail negative space for later subtitles, with no crucial objects there. Make the specified story state visually understandable. Text: NONE. No words, labels, subtitles, numbers, logos, watermark, speech bubbles, panels, frames or collage. Do not reproduce model sheets, multiple versions of a character, or wardrobe lineups. Each named character appears exactly once. This is a new single coherent scene, not a copy of the references. No motion streaks or implied camera zoom. Never turn a metaphor into a real transformation: yellow blankets remain fabric, imagined grassy softness is not actual grass growing in bed. No new story events. 
Reference input 2 is the fixed object anchor for LEAF_01: one narrow pale spring-green willow leaf with a gently curved pointed tip and a fine pale central vein. Reproduce this same single individual leaf exactly; it must be clearly visible in the upper half. No extra leaves on the water. For shots with Pipi: keep his eyes softly open and attentive toward the leaf, expression calm and interested, not sad or sleepy. Targeted edit: make the same LEAF_01 clearly visible in the calm water.
